shots.name: A/S 관리 — 완료일시 · 날짜/시간 범위 · 잇기 창 하단 단추
steps: expect:(() => { const g = document.querySelector('[role=dialog] [role=group][aria-label="날짜/시간"]'); return !!g && g.querySelectorAll('select').length === 6 && g.textContent.includes('~') && g.querySelector('select[aria-label="시작 시"]').options[4].text === '오전 04' && g.querySelector('select[aria-label="끝 시"]').options[13].text === '오후 13' })()
js:(() => { const m = [...document.querySelectorAll('.ec-modal-back')].pop(); [...m.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === '닫기').click(); return true })()

js:(() => { const d = document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); const el = d.querySelector('input[placeholder="제목"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, 'QA그룹웨어-AS범위'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true })()

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/work-posts?board=AS_CARE', { headers: H })).json(); const p = d.find((x) => x.title === 'QA그룹웨어-AS범위'); const ex = JSON.parse(p.extraFields || '{}'); return /^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d \d\d:\d\d~\d\d:\d\d$/.test(ex['날짜/시간'] || '') && !!p.completedAt })().then((x) => 'range ' + x)

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const d = await (await fetch('/api/work-posts?board=AS_CARE', { headers: H })).json(); const out = []; for (const p of d.filter((x) => x.title.startsWith('QA그룹웨어-'))) out.push((await fetch('/api/work-posts/' + p.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H })).status); return 'del ' + out.join(',') })()
